title: IslamicMMLU: A Benchmark for Evaluating LLMs on Islamic Knowledge
reasoning: The paper introduces IslamicMMLU, a benchmark specifically designed to evaluate Large Language Models on their knowledge of Islamic scripture (Quran), prophetic traditions (Hadith), and jurisprudence (Fiqh). It explicitly evaluates religious knowledge and includes a novel task for detecting bias toward different schools of Islamic thought (madhahib).
